exams.name: Clinical dental licensing examination (national, regional, or independent third-party)
exams.notes: Applicant must apply for licensure within five years of passing; board must approve the specific examination
exams.quote: An applicant who has successfully completed any national, regional, or independent third-party clinical dental licensing examination approved by the board and who otherwise satisfies all requirements for a dental license, including satisfactory completion of an examination in jurisprudence and a background check, may be granted a license by examination by applying for licensure in Louisiana within five years following the successful completion of such clinical licensing examination.

exams.quote: satisfactory completion of an examination in jurisprudence and a background check

required.quote: Require and determine by rule, minimum requirements relative to continuing education for relicensure and recertification.

topical_requirements.quote: Failing to maintain certification in an approved course of cardiopulmonary resuscitation for the renewal of a dental license.

available.quote: This Chapter shall not be construed to allow licensure by reciprocity which is prohibited.

requirements.value: Reciprocity is expressly prohibited. Licensure by credentials is available for dentists holding a license in another state. Louisiana has also enacted the Interstate Dental and Dental Hygiene Licensure Compact for expedited licensure.
requirements.quote: Licensure by credentials shall be utilized to evaluate a dentist's and dental hygienist's theoretical knowledge and clinical skill when an applicant for licensure by credentials holds a dental or dental hygiene license in another state.

exists.quote: There is hereby created within the Louisiana Department of Health the Louisiana State Board of Dentistry, referred to hereafter in this Chapter as the "board", which shall carry out the purposes and enforce the provisions of this Chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Affliction with a contagious or infectious disease
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Affliction with a contagious or infectious disease.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a crime or guilty/nolo contendere plea
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a crime or entry of a plea of guilty or nolo contendere to a criminal charge.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud, deceit, or perjury in obtaining any diploma, license, or permit
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud, deceit, or perjury in obtaining any diploma, license, or permit issued under the provisions of this Chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Providing false testimony before the board or in judicial proceedings
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Providing false testimony before the board or in any judicial proceeding.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual indulgence in the use of drugs, narcotics, or intoxicating liquors
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitual indulgence in the use of drugs, narcotics, or intoxicating liquors.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, dispensing, or administering habit-forming or controlled substances in other than a legal or legitimate manner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing, dispensing, or administering habit-forming or other legally controlled substances in other than a legal or legitimate manner.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Professional or dental incompetency
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Professional or dental incompetency.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dental practice which fails to satisfy prevailing acceptable standards
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dental practice which fails to satisfy the prevailing acceptable standards of dental practice in this state.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Division of fees or remuneration with any unlicensed person or agreement to divide fees for patient referrals
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Division of fees or other remuneration or consideration with any person not licensed to practice dentistry in Louisiana, or an agreement to divide and share fees received for dental services with any non-dentists in return for referral of patients to the licensed dentists

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing, inducing, or aiding an unlicensed person to practice dentistry or possess ownership interest in dental practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employing, procuring, inducing, aiding, or abetting a person not licensed or registered as a dentist to engage in the practice of dentistry or to possess an ownership interest of any kind in a dental practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing unlicensed persons to perform work reserved for licensed practitioners
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employing unlicensed persons to perform work which under this Chapter can be done only by persons licensed to practice dentistry or dental hygiene in this state.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making misrepresentations or false promises to influence dental patronage
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making any misrepresentations or false promises, directly or indirectly, to influence, persuade, or induce dental patronage.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Professional connection with another for illegal practice or with persons holding themselves out contrary to this Chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Professional connection or association with, or lending his name to, another for the illegal practice of dentistry by another, or professional connection or association with any person holding himself out in any manner contrary to this Chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing under any name other than that on the license or renewal certificate
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing under any name other than that which appears on the license or renewal certificate, the dentist's commonly used name, or the name which is authorized under Chapter 11 of Title 12

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unprofessional conduct as defined in R.S. 37:775
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unprofessional conduct as defined in R.S. 37:775.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any conduct intended to deceive or defraud the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any conduct intended to deceive or defraud the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conduct disqualifying the licensee from practicing dentistry with safety to the public, including mental or physical illness
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conduct which disqualifies the licensee to practice dentistry with safety to the public, including inability to practice dentistry with reasonable skill or safety to patients because of mental illness or deficiency or physical illness

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusal, revocation, suspension, or restriction of license by another state licensing authority
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The refusal of a licensing authority of another state to issue or renew a license, permit, or certificate to practice dentistry in that state, or the revocation, suspension, or other restriction imposed upon a license, permit, or certificate issued by such licensing authority

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing solicitors or paying anything of value to secure patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employing solicitors or subsidizing anyone, or paying or presenting any person money or anything of value for the purpose of securing patients, except as allowed by R.S. 37:775.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusing to submit to board-appointed physical or mental examinations or failing to comply with recommendations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Refusing to submit to the examinations and inquiry of medical physicians appointed or designated by the board to inquire into the dentist's physical and mental fitness and ability to practice dentistry with reasonable skill and safety to patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making or submitting false or deceptive claims for monetary compensation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making or submitting false or deceptive claims to any patient, insurance company, or indemnity association, company, individual, or governmental authority for the purpose of obtaining monetary compensation for services rendered.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Immoral conduct in exercising license privileges
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Immoral conduct in exercising the privileges provided for by license or permit issued under this Chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Interdiction or commitment by due process of law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Interdiction or commitment by due process of law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any rule, regulation, or order of the board, or any provision of this Chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any rule, regulation, or order of the board, consent decree agreed upon between the board and the licensee, or any provision of this Chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to pay timely a dentist license renewal fee
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The failure to pay timely a dentist license renewal fee as required by law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Non-disclosure of waiving of co-payments to any third party payor
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Non-disclosure of waiving of co-payments to any third party payor.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to cooperate with the board in investigating any matter or failing to respond to lawful demands
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to cooperate with the board in investigating any matter before the board except for an openly expressed claim of a constitutional privilege; or knowingly failing to respond to a lawful demand from the board for information from any professional licensing or disciplinary authority.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to maintain certification in an approved CPR course for license renewal
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to maintain certification in an approved course of cardiopulmonary resuscitation for the renewal of a dental license.

definition_quote.value: Dentistry means the evaluation, diagnosis, prevention, or treatment, including nonsurgical, surgical, or related procedures, of diseases, disorders, or conditions of the oral cavity, maxillofacial areas or the adjacent and associated structures and their impact on the human body provided by a dentist within the scope of his education, training, and experience, in accordance with the ethics of the profession and applicable law.
definition_quote.quote: "Dentistry" means the evaluation, diagnosis, prevention, or treatment, including nonsurgical, surgical, or related procedures, of diseases, disorders, or conditions of the oral cavity, maxillofacial areas or the adjacent and associated structures and their impact on the human body provided by a dentist within the scope of his education, training, and experience, in accordance with the ethics of the profession and applicable law.

sedation_adverse_event_reporting_require.quote: Each licensed dentist or dental hygienist in the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene in this state shall submit a written report within a period of ten days to the board of any mortality or other incident which results in temporary or permanent physical or mental injury to a patient requiring hospitalization of the patient during or as a result of administration by the dentist or dental hygienist of local anesthesia, enteral sedation, nitrous oxide inhalation analgesia, parenteral moderate sedation, deep sedation, or general anesthesia.

dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: A licensed dental hygienist may operate under a licensed Louisiana dentist's direct or general supervision as defined in LAC 46:XXXIII.108, within the limits prescribed by the board in LAC 46:XXXIII.701.

mobile_dental_facility_registration_requ.quote: Upon promulgation of rules pursuant to this Section and R.S. 37:796, a person offering dental services at a mobile dental clinic or a location other than the dental office shall...
